SERVICES / FOUNDER-LED

Small Business Website Design & Development

A clear website for your business, with a defined scope and a practical route from first brief to handover.

Who this is for

Small service businesses that need a first website or a redesign that makes their offer and enquiry journey easier to understand. Also suitable for an agreed landing-page or brochure-site project.

Deliverables you can agree before work starts

A page inventory, content responsibilities, responsive layouts, development, agreed booking or enquiry integration, technical search foundations, browser and accessibility checks, launch preparation and documented handover.

  • Define the business audience and desired next action.
  • List each page, reusable component and integration.
  • Document title, heading, canonical and redirect requirements.
  • Agree acceptance criteria and ownership of accounts and files.

What is outside the starting scope

Ecommerce transactions, customer accounts, complex applications, extensive copywriting, photography and ongoing campaigns are separate work. Provider subscriptions, hosting and domains are included only when the proposal says so. A form is complete only when real delivery is tested.

New website or redesign?

For a new website, start with the offer, audience and content. For a redesign, first inventory current URLs, useful content and working integrations; preserve or redirect them deliberately. Similar website-design and redesign questions belong in this service scope, rather than separate near-duplicate pages.

Process and approval points

Discovery → written scope → content and layout approval → development preview → acceptance checks → approved launch → handover. Feedback rounds, dependencies and delivery dates are agreed in the proposal.

Commercial approach

Request a tailored quote. Project fees follow the agreed pages, interactions, content and migration work. Changes receive a written cost and timing assessment before starting; recurring support is scoped separately.

Evidence you can inspect

Olive & Earth shows product browsing and a demonstration bag. Form / Space shows project navigation and a demonstration consultation brief. These are original concepts, not client projects or proof of sales results. SiteSutra itself demonstrates static HTML, CSS and JavaScript delivery.

Prepare a useful brief

Use the scope guide and downloadable brief, redesign inventory and quote comparison guide before we talk.

Discuss your project.

Bring your current website, audience, priorities and any constraints. We’ll use the discovery call to decide whether the work is a good fit, then agree a written scope.
